blocks.text: Those alarmed by Anandpur carry their complaints upward, warning rulers that if the Guru is not checked now he will be impossible to contain once armies gather around him. (10–12)
The intrigue hardens into direct hostility, and the Guru answers the treachery of masands and local enemies with open anger, punishment, and a further cleansing of corrupt intermediaries. (13–17)
What had begun as slander around Anandpur now becomes the prelude to siege and war, with political complaint turning into military mobilization. (overall)
